name: Oberoi Springs
address: Off New Link Road, near Citi Mall, Oshiwara, Andheri West, Mumbai 400053
amenities: Indoor and outdoor children's play areas
description: Three 35-storey towers with 645 apartments on about 7 acres off New Link Road in Oshiwara, Andheri West, built by Oberoi Realty's subsidiary with Larsen & Toubro as civil contractor. Construction started in November 2005 and the occupation certificate came in October 2009. Homes run from 2.5 BHK (about 850 sq ft carpet) to large 4-5 BHK units, and several film personalities live there.
notes: Per Oberoi Realty's Jan 2010 DRHP: development rights over 6.83 acres were acquired in Feb 2005 from Excel Industries (3.61 acres) and the Shroff Family Charitable Trust (3.22 acres), plus 0.14 acres bought from Oshiwara Land Development Co in Apr 2005, for Rs 31.72 crore in total. The DRHP gives a saleable area of 643,065 sq ft, 620 of 645 units sold by 30 Sep 2009, construction from Nov 2005, OC in Oct 2009, and a target market of the 'upper middle income segment'. A buyer's July 2009 notice claimed possession was due from 1 Jul 2008, so handover may have run late against some agreements. Conflicts: Square Yards gives 16.49 acres and 630 units, and listings give 17 acres; DRHP figures are used here. Mumbai Property Exchange says 36 storeys and Square Yards 'up to 22', while the DRHP says 35. No launch date was found: Mumbai Property Exchange's earliest price record is Apr 2005 and the name 'Oberoi Springs' dates from Oct 2005. Hema Malini's Aug 2025 sale works out to Rs 73,790/sq ft on 847 sq ft carpet, or Rs 61,455 on 1,017 sq ft built-up. That is well above Square Yards' 12-month registered average of Rs 42,200 and asking average of about Rs 46,000, so per-flat premiums (high floor, views) may explain the gap. The 2005-2007 rates (Rs 5,250, 7,750, 11,756) come from Mumbai Property Exchange's historical series and are unverified. Mumbai Property Exchange gives the Metro 2A/2B Yellow Line 1.7 km away and the under-construction Line 6 0.5 km away (straight line). Launch basis (Nov 2026 top-up): the Jan 2010 DRHP (sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/1294984013064.pdf) gives Springs' saleable area, units sold and OC date but no launch price or year-wise sales value, and no other dated launch price was found, so the 2005 launch point stays at the portal's unknown-basis Rs 5,250. Springs' 643,065 sq ft for 645 units is about 997 sq ft a flat, against flats of 1,017 sq ft built-up / 847 sq ft carpet in 2024-25 deeds, which supports the IP-Mar11 footnote that the company figures are on built-up area.

news.title: Oberoi acquires development rights for Oberoi Springs land from Excel Industries and Shroff Family Charitable Trust
news.summary: Development agreements covering 6.83 of the 6.97 acres were signed on 10 Feb 2005 for Rs 31.71 crore; the remaining 0.14 acres was bought in Apr 2005.

news.title: Buyer notice alleges delayed possession at Oberoi Springs (disclosed in DRHP)
news.summary: A buyer claimed Rs 2.2 million plus 24% interest from 1 Jul 2008 for delayed handover. Oberoi denied the allegations, and no proceedings had started.

news.title: Oberoi Springs receives occupation certificate
news.summary: Oberoi's IPO filing says the three-tower, 645-unit project received its OC in October 2009, with 620 units sold.

news.title: Bollywood star Mrunal Thakur purchases luxury apartment in Oberoi Springs for INR 10 crore
news.summary: Mrunal Thakur and her father bought two adjoining flats from Kangana Ranaut's brother and father for Rs 5 Cr each (Zapkey documents).

news.title: Hema Malini sells 2 apartments for Rs 12.50 cr in Mumbai
news.summary: Two 31st-floor flats of 847 sq ft carpet each sold for Rs 6.25 Cr each, registered in Aug 2025 (IGR documents via Square Yards).
